Remark
[explicit conformal factor for constant curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0178 ↗ rem:pet-ch4-ex-19 1. ch4:4.7.21Let $(M^n,g)$, $n>2$, have constant curvature $k$. (1) Use exercise 4.7.19 to show the metric is locally conformally flat. (2) If $g=e^{-2\psi }\big((dx^1)^2+\dots +(dx^n)^2\big)$, show $2e^\psi \partial _i\partial _j\psi =\big(k+\sum _k(\partial _ke^\psi )^2\big)\delta _{ij}$. (3) Show $e^\psi =a+\sum _ib_ix^i+c\sum _i(x^i)^2$ with $k=4ac-\sum _ib_i^2$.
